result: Narrowed; original status retained. For any commutative ring and finite hinge set, the action S=sum_h A_h*(tau-sum_j theta_hj) equals tau*sum_h A_h-sum_h A_h*sum_j theta_hj. For fixed deficits it is linear in the declared areas, and splitting an area while keeping its deficit fixed preserves its contribution. Zero deficits imply zero action. Declared integer data also show that zero total action need not mean zero deficits, and changing areas can change the action on the same finite index set.
proof_boundary: Areas, angles and the full-turn parameter are declared algebraic data. Geometric realizability, actual triangulation moves, Lorentzian signature, convergence to the Einstein-Hilbert action, and fermion-sign consequences are not established.
